title: Apply ABAC policies to shared views, materialized views, and streaming tables
body: You can now apply attribute-based access control (ABAC) [row filters and column masks](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/abac/policies) to views, materialized views, and streaming tables shared through OpenSharing. Shared views are in Beta and require the ABAC on views preview. See [OpenSharing and ABAC](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/abac/opensharing).
